note: Documented practices support reasoning operations, not named-style imitation. Each is descriptive practitioner evidence, not universal experimental validation.

methods.name: Massimo Vignelli
methods.transferable_operation: Ask what is meant, how elements relate, whether the recipient understands; do not prescribe grids
methods.limitations: Publisher description of book; source-specific doctrine, not validated universal effect

methods.name: Dieter Rams
methods.reported_focus: Understandability, utility, honest expression, rigorous finishing
methods.transferable_operation: Audit detail and unnecessary friction; no obligation to minimal aesthetics
methods.limitations: Museum synthesis; product design cannot transfer verbatim to all digital UI

methods.name: Paula Scher
methods.reported_focus: Learn what the client and audience really need before formal proposal
methods.transferable_operation: Ask hard early questions; derive form from the answer, not from Scher visual signatures
methods.limitations: Partial interview/excerpt reviewed; do not imply all projects use identical method

methods.name: Michael Bierut
methods.reported_focus: Keep early concepts flexible; use notes and surprises to revise
methods.transferable_operation: Record initial concepts then test against what emerges
methods.limitations: Self-report, not an experiment; do not clone visual style

methods.name: Susan Kare
methods.reported_focus: Generate several symbol choices and test recognition at real scale
methods.transferable_operation: Translate a concept into alternatives; test what users recognize
methods.limitations: Historical icon practice and informal testing; not every metaphor travels

methods.name: Muriel Cooper
methods.reported_focus: Shorten feedback via experimenting with tools and media
methods.transferable_operation: Prototype in real interaction medium; observe change in context
methods.limitations: Curatorial synthesis not direct interview, no claim of causal advantage

methods.name: IDEO design practice
methods.reported_focus: Empathy, generating choices, converging after tests
methods.transferable_operation: Gather actual user context when possible, prototype and learn iteratively
methods.limitations: Studio methodology not guaranteed optimal nor universal step-by-step law
